Data Availability Statement
All federated training code, partitioning scripts,
compression implementations, and evaluation
results are deposited in the Zenodo repository

Ethical Approval
This study used publicly available datasets. eICU
access obtained through PhysioNet credentialing.
No patient data were collected or processed
beyond the de-identified eICU dataset. No
institutional ethical approval was required beyond
PhysioNet data use agreement.
